metadata.case_name: TSANG CHOI PING v. LI YIN LUN

plaintiff.occupation_before: General worker (Yau Hing Food Processing) and general worker (restaurant operated by Defendant)

injuries.description: A second degree burn of approximately 9% total body surface area was found over bilateral legs from knee down to foot dorsum mainly anteriorly.
source: A second degree burn of approximately 9% total body surface area was found over bilateral legs from knee down to foot dorsum mainly anteriorly.
The diagnosis given was “scald both feet” (sic).
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the knee or lower leg

injuries.description: Dr Nicolson opines that the Plaintiff has permanent cosmetic disability as a result of her burn injury. The scars of her right foot became hypertrophic subsequent to their healing. "in the distal 1/3 the scar measures 9.5 x 7 cm and is raised, thickened and darkly pigmented with mild active pinkish hypertrophic scar in parts;" "flexion of the toes lacks 30°. When flexed the scar pulls on the skin of the proximal foot;"
source: Dr Nicolson opines that the Plaintiff has permanent cosmetic disability as a result of her burn injury. The scars of her right foot became hypertrophic subsequent to their healing.

"flexion of the toes lacks 30°. When flexed the scar pulls on the skin of the proximal foot;"
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the ankle or foot

manifestations.description: pain and discomfort in the scars in her right foot and occasionally in the left foot
occasional cramps in her feet at night
itch and discomfort in the scars in her right foot
cannot walk or stand for any prolonged periods
when sitting, she periodically must elevate her feet

treatments_received: follow-up treatment and dressing in out-patient clinic
treatments_future: Intralesion cortisone injections into the active scar
Silicone gel to apply to the hypertrophic scar

losses.description: Unsightly and conspicuous scars over her legs and feet; ugly scars on her feet and she always have to wear socks in order to conceal her scars.

Cannot walk or stand for any prolonged periods; must elevate her feet when sitting; prevented from standing or walking for long hours and from lifting heavy weight; affected ability to discharge heavy work.
